page.overview:
What is Dentaal Uprising?

The Dentaal Uprising occurred on the planet Dentaal during the Galactic Civil War when the Dentaal Independence Party overthrew Imperial Governor Taliff. The Empire responded by deploying the Candorian plague to the planet and killing the world's entire population.
